sections.skill: Write and apply a fair cancellation policy

questions.prompt: Why have a cancellation policy?

choices.text: Last-minute cancellations leave slots you may not fill
Because the law requires the same policy everywhere
To stop customers from ever booking again
To avoid writing any expectations at all

questions.correct_answer: Last-minute cancellations leave slots you may not fill
questions.intro: A CANCELLATION POLICY says what happens if a customer cancels: for example, "full refund if cancelled 7 days before; 50 percent refund within 7 days; no refund within 24 hours." Policies protect your time, because a last-minute cancellation leaves a slot you may not fill. Set EXPECTATIONS too: what the customer will receive, when, and how to contact you. Share the policy before booking, apply it consistently, and allow exceptions only on purpose, such as emergencies.

sections.skill: Saving a seat at a show

questions.prompt: A booked appointment is like what?

choices.text: A seat held at a show

questions.correct_answer: A seat held at a show
questions.intro: When you buy a theater ticket, the theater holds a seat for you and turns other people away. If you cancel an hour before, the seat is probably empty. That is why tickets often have rules about refunds. A service business is similar: an appointment holds a slot of the owner's time. A cancellation policy is the ticket rules for that slot.
